properties/url: Absolute public HTTP(S) URL without embedded credentials.
properties/headers: Request headers, including authentication or content type when needed.
properties/params: Query parameters appended to the URL.
properties/body: Literal UTF-8 request body; mutually exclusive with json_body.
properties/json_body: Structured JSON request body, serialized once by the HTTP client.
properties/timeout: Request timeout in seconds, default 120; range 1–600.
